Statistik per-run Lab jadi collapsible default tertutup / Lab per-run stats collapsible, default collapsed

2026-09-28 10:48:44featreleasedv0.1.0
ID
2026-09-28-lab-stats-collapsible
Commit
4419c1d8158aa611f3d218e0706bb3155f159cf8
Summary
ID: 3 chart per-run LabStats (token/latensi/kecepatan) dibungkus details native default-collapsed; KPI dan tabel peringkat tetap tampil. / EN: The 3 LabStats per-run charts (tokens/latency/speed) are wrapped in native collapsed-by-default details; KPI and ranking tables stay visible.

Prior Condition & Problem

ID: Tiga chart per-run selalu terbuka membuat halaman /lab panjang dan berisik atas request user. / EN: The three per-run charts were always open, making the /lab page long and noisy, per user request.

Reason & Motivation

ID: Halaman hasil lebih ringkas; pola details native sudah dipakai di LabCompareGrid dan LabHistory, DOM tetap ada saat closed (aman screen reader, test existing tak patah). / EN: Shorter results page; the native details pattern already exists in LabCompareGrid and LabHistory, DOM stays present when closed (screen-reader safe, existing tests unbroken).

Applied Solution

ID: Bungkus 3 blok chart (tokensPerRun, latencyPerRun, speedPerRun) dengan

native tanpa atribut open; summary memakai judul chart existing; tabel sr-only ikut di dalam. / EN: Wrapped the 3 chart blocks in native details without the open attribute; summary reuses existing chart titles; the sr-only table moves inside.

Affected Files

  • src/components/lab/LabStats.tsx
  • src/components/lab/LabUi.test.tsx

Impact

User Impact: ID: Chart per-run tertutup default, klik judul untuk membuka; tanpa key i18n baru. / EN: Per-run charts collapsed by default, click a title to open; no new i18n keys.

Technical Impact: ID: Perubahan komponen klien saja; pilihan buka/tutup tidak persisten antar reload (native details). / EN: Client-component change only; open/closed choice does not persist across reloads (native details).

Validation Evidence

build: not-verified: build outcome not recorded for 4419c1d / test: 1174/1174 tests passed (per project memory 2026-09-28) / lint: typecheck passed, eslint 0 errors with 12 pre-existing warnings (per project memory 2026-09-28)

Risks & Limitations

  • ID: Test memakai closest('details') karena getAllByRole('details') tak cocok di versi testing-library dipakai. / EN: Tests use closest('details') because getAllByRole('details') does not match in the testing-library version used.

Breaking Changes

    Migration Notes: None

    Next Steps

    • ID: Verifikasi live di /id/lab (chart tertutup, KPI tampil). / EN: Live-verify in /id/lab (charts closed, KPIs visible).
